response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent communication abilities, and solid CI/CD knowledge, he fundamentally lacks the two mandatory requirements for this role. His C++ experience is limited to approximately 6 months at National Instruments, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on professional C++ development. More critically, he has zero exposure to capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial services domains—at least one is required. His entire career has focused on web, mobile, and modern cloud-based systems using TypeScript, Node.js, and other non-Windows technologies, representing a fundamental mismatch with the position's core technical and domain requirements.
strengths: Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing demonstrated through conference talks, workshops, and community-driven projects
Strong grasp of modern software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD pipelines, trunk-based development, and code quality principles
Extensive professional experience (20 years) with demonstrated ability to learn diverse technical stacks and mentor others
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: only ~6 months of demonstrated professional C++ experience versus the mandatory 5–10 years required
Complete absence of any capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial services domain exposure
Career entirely focused on web and cloud technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than Windows-based C++ systems and financial platforms
